name: de Broglie’s matter-wave hypothesis
description: Association of material particles with wave phenomena.

impact.note: A new idea among physicists that matter has wave properties; wave mechanics and electron diffraction followed directly from it.

date.basis: Dated source witness, not a claim that the idea originated on this date.

events.statement: De Broglie’s note associating a wave with a moving material body was presented by Jean Perrin to the Academy of Sciences on 10 September 1923.

evidence.supports: The scanned paper associates a wave with a moving material object and identifies the 10 September 1923 session; Jean Perrin presented it.
